name: Empty credentials are rejected by the Dev login form
description:
Objective: Empty credentials are rejected by the Dev login form.
Preconditions: Open Notification portal dev env with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Notification portal dev env.
2. Empty credentials are rejected by the Dev login form.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Sign In must not proceed when email and password are empty.
